questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All stars are white.

II. All white are moon.

III. No moon is blue.

**Conclusions:**

I**. **Some moon are stars.

II. No blue is stars.

III. Some white are stars.

IV. Some blue are white.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff70a1afc2746d7d821617098a26d8632dc3cb23fc6907998394147fee66c840.png] 

I. Some moon are stars → True

II. No blue is stars → True

III. Some white are stars → True

IV. Some blue are white → False

Hence, Only conclusion (I), (II), and (III) follow.

questions.question: In a certain code language, "PEN-TAN" is written as "0". How is "DEN-COB" written in that code language?
questions.solution:
Summing up the alphabetical positions of the letters of the word,

PEN – TAN → (16 + 5 + 14) – (20 + 1 + 14) = 0

DEN – COB → (4 + 5 + 14) – (3 + 15 + 2) = 3

Hence, "3" is correct answer.

questions.question:
Three positions of a cube are shown below. What will come opposite to face containing ‘5’?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76cbe45743587bc75e19c239778a4dc4239ce6d6c511dc93435c0d1e9f188a53.png]
questions.solution:
The four adjacent sides to face containing ‘5’ are ‘3’, ‘6’, ‘4’ and ‘2’. Therefore the opposite side to ‘5’ should be faced containing ‘1’.

**Trick:**

How to easily find the opposite faces:

Choose any 2 dices which have only one number in common.

As in, I and II only 5 is common.

Now move clockwise as per the dice.

In I, 5 - 3 - 6 

In II, 5 - 2 - 4

So, we can observe that 3 is opposite to 2 and 6 is opposite to 4. 

Now only 5 is left, which will be opposite to 1.

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of Anil and Aakash is 4 : 5. Three years later their ages will be in ratio 7 : 8. What is the present age (in years) of Anil?
questions.solution:
Let present ages of Anil and Akash be 4x and 5x.

Their ages 3 years later will be (4x + 3) and (5x + 3) respectively.

Given, (4x + 3) / (5x + 3) = 7 / 8

⇒ 32x + 24 = 35x + 21

⇒ x = 1

Therefore, present ages of Anil is 4 years.

**Trick:**

According to the question,

 4 : 5

 (+3)↓ ↓(+3) (This ratio changes by 3 after 3 years)

 7 : 8 

In implies,

3 values = 3 years

so, 1 values = 1 year

So, Anil's age (at present) = 4 × 1 = 4 years

Aakash's age = 5 × 1 = 5 years

Hence, after 3 years, their ages will be 7 and 8 years respectively.

3, 4, 5, 4, 9, 10, 6, 16, 15, 9, 25, 20, 13, 36, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern follows here is-

3 _ _ 4 _ _ 6 _ _ 9 _ _ 13 _ _ 18 (+1, +2, +3, +4, +5 and so on)

_ 4 _ _ 9 _ _ 16 _ _ 25 _ _ 36 _ _ 49 (2², 3², 4², 5², 6² and so on)

_ _ 5 _ _ 10 _ _ 15 _ _ 20 _ _ 25 (5 × 1, × 2, × 3, × 4, × 5 and so on)

Therefore, the next term should be 25.

7 : 48 : : 11 : ?

Karan remembers that his sister's birthday is not after 18th August. Karan's mother remembers that Karan's sister's birthday is before 20th August but after 17th August. On which date of August is Karan's sister birthday?
questions.solution:
Karan's sister's birthday is before 20th August but after 17th August. 

Birthday can be on 18th or 19th. birthday is not after 18th August.

Hence, the birthday is on 18th August.

**Trick:**

Not after 18 means, on 18 or before 18.

Before 20 and after 17 means, on 18 or 19.

The only common date is 18.

Hence, the birthday is on 18th August.
